pathway.description: A: schizophrenia diagnosis, D: unemployment, E: chronic homelessness. Coarser abstraction collapsing B (substance abuse) and C (social support loss) into direct A->D edge.

target._estimate: HUD 2024 Point-in-Time count: ~153,000 chronically homeless / ~335M US population = 0.000457

_rationale: Schizophrenia has 70-90% unemployment rate (literature: Marwaha & Johnson 2004, Rosenheck et al. 2006). Using P(D|A)=0.80 as the direct causal estimate. This is a trivariate abstraction collapsing B and C into the A->D edge, consistent with the paper Example 4.8 abstraction framework.
